title: Marcello SWap
tagline: DeFi swap project in solidity built with foundry and solidity
description: Simple swap protocol implemented in plain solidity. It is not a huge project in terms of baseline or in terms of creativity but that what I have been able to do in my spare time. Hope you like it, I belive it could potentially be used for an educational purpose and it was fun realizing it
how_its_made: The projects uses foundry as the main solidity framework, being foundry particularly user friendly and super fast.  It is not a huge project in terms of baseline or in terms of creativity but that what I have been able to do in my spare time. Hope you like it
